## TreeNodeInfo.rerootAbove property

Spread into the selection to reroot halfway along the branch drawn above this node (`null` for the root) — correct even when the tree is already rerooted; see [rerootAbove()](./react-bio-viz.rerootabove.md)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
rerootAbove: Pick<TreeSelection, "rerootedAt" | "rerootPosition"> | null;
```
